##: Upstream publishes the full package (fonts + offline dictionary) only in some releases; the versions in between ship just the main EXE. checkver therefore cannot use releases/latest, and a plain api.github.com url would be anonymous and rate limited, so it queries the release list with a token and reports the newest release that actually contains the full archive. per_page must stay at 100 - the gap between full packages has already been 43 releases (3.7.43 -> 3.7.87). Like every checkver.script, it must return rather than throw: an uncaught throw aborts the bucket-wide checkver run.
description: Unofficial fork of SumatraPDF, a document reader (PDF, EPUB, MOBI, and more) with improvements for Chinese ebooks, offline lookup, themes, and smart PDF dark mode
notes: Full package includes fonts and offline dictionary for double-click word lookup.
This is a community fork of SumatraPDF (GPLv3), not an official release from sumatrapdfreader.org.
